note: Guides are original writing for this entry, based on the official descriptions and the sources cited beside each trophy. Two trophies (Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin) were unconfirmed at launch and are marked so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. There are no online trophies and no DLC is needed, so a single playthrough plus the post-story cleanup is the whole road. PowerPyx puts the full journey at roughly 200 hours at a 4/10 difficulty, with the 100% Completion checklist the longest single job.
steps: Finish the story (5 chapters, roughly 60–80 hours).
Work through the roadmap stages below: side strands, activities, collectibles and grinds.
Attain 100% Completion for “A Long Road”, then this platinum unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. You cannot miss it — just play the opening mission through to its end and the trophy pops.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops after you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?”, so the chapter trophy follows naturally from playing the story onward. Nothing optional is needed.
steps: Play through Chapter 1, then start Chapter 2 with “What’s in the Bag?”.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, “Welcome to Vice City”, so keep playing the story and it arrives on its own. The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation publishes it.
steps: Play through Chapter 2, then start Chapter 3 with “Welcome to Vice City”.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”, so it is simply a matter of playing the story forward.
steps: Play through Chapter 3, then the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, “Starting From Zero”, which is also the mission that ends the story, so this and the final-mission trophy arrive together.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission, “Starting From Zero”.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy for finishing the final mission of the game. PowerPyx lists the final mission as “Starting From Zero” at the end of Chapter 4, so the gold pops the moment the story ends. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of the final mission if you want a safety net.
steps: Finish the story’s final mission, “Starting From Zero”.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission through and the trophy pops as part of the story — no extra objective is involved.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Just play the heist mission through; the trophy is tied to completing it, not to any optional objective inside it.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child’s Play. Play the mission through and the trophy pops when it ends.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child’s Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Play the mission through; there is nothing to do beyond completing it.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Play the mission through and the trophy pops at its end.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy: it unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the mission through; it is the last of the named-mission story trophies.
steps: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the last one most players earn: reach 100% on the Completion checklist, which only opens after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses the checklist is forgiving — closer to 60% true completion — because most side quests are not required and collectibles are only partly required: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, any 100 optional missions, and 15 of 18 meditations. The parts that do need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret’s quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable, and everything can be finished in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals as you play.
Complete any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts.
Clear every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds — 130 Stunt Jumps over ramps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights between buildings and 25 Base Jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the quickest: Under the Bridges are the fastest to tick off. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and stays marked once done. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
steps: Pick a stunt type — Under the Bridges are quickest — and complete any 250.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for progress by region.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest. You will be introduced to most of them by the story, and working on the other trophies covers nearly all of them anyway.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you still need.
Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting-range locations. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 12 locations and the 42 gold medals. The challenges are not too hard, and golding them also raises your Focus level, which helps with the Gunslinger trophy. All 42 are required for the 100% checklist too, so this is a must-do rather than a skippable grind.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges and attempt its challenges.
Earn gold on all 42 challenges — PowerPyx lists every location.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 drone-race locations (42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx). You only need one win per location, not every race at each spot. All drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so expect to spend real time here after the story.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at each location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice — you do not need to win the same race twice, and each distinct race you win counts once. Race wins also feed the activity types for “Master of None” and count toward the 100% checklist.
steps: Enter races at different locations and win 20 of them.
Each new location won counts; repeats of the same race do not.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The questline starts after the Chapter 1 main mission “Feng Shui (Meet Cal)”: Cal will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there and beat him in the challenge he sets.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui (Meet Cal)”.
Wait for Cal’s text, then follow the purple fishing marker.
Complete his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all its levels at least once. PowerPyx names the four in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck, found at arcade machines around the world. You do not need to beat every challenge in a game, just reach its end, and any of the four counts, so pick the one you enjoy most.
steps: Play any of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
Finish all of its levels once to complete it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3. PowerPyx says that while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address marking the questline in Belville. All of her quests stay available after the story. Complete her five quests — “Climbing the Cellerichain” (parts 1–3), “Pay the Cellerica Fee”, “Peach!”, “Read the Label” and “Puff Puff Pass” — and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and answer Andy’s call, then follow her address in Belville.
Complete all five Andy quests, ending with “Puff Puff Pass”.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s optional questline. It gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission “Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)” he calls you and is marked by the green “KR” icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving for shipwrecks — purple treasure-chest icons on the map — where you use a metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back to him. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton’s Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable.
steps: After “Island Dreams”, follow Kenton’s call to the green “KR” icon in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and return the treasure, 7 in total.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s optional questline, which gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission “Coffee Break”, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All his quests stay available after the story. Complete his five quests — “Thrillbillies”, “Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab”, “Mall Rats”, “The Impaler” and “Hometown Heroes” — and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: After “Coffee Break”, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five Billy quests, ending with “Hometown Heroes”.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. PowerPyx warns that only certain questlines count — the optional questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count so far are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests: “Skunk Apeology 101”, “Search for Tree Effigies”, “Advanced Skunk Apeonomics”), Kyle (“Check Out McKittrick Farm”, “Collect Chemicals for Kyle”, “Buddy?”), Yago (the street-race mentoring strand) and Pilot Pete (the “Last Mile” deliveries). PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being found, and all of them remain available after the story in free-roam.
steps: Find Strangers & Freaks in the open world — they stay available after the story.
Finish 8 strands that count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s optional questline, “Randy’s Wish List”. It gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS”, in which you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Granforma Zorrusso is delivered automatically during that mission. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy’s Wish List; he marks some cars for you, but you can also steal them off the street, and scanning with the Waink app shows whether a car is on the list. Deliver each to his garage, marked by the green “RK” icon in the west of Vice City; good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story.
steps: Finish “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS” to unlock Randy’s list and the Key Cloner.
Steal and deliver the 16 sports cars on his wish list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s optional questline, which is only available as Jason and gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”. Purple markers point you to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them in the quest “Take Out Kitty Litter”. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, “Spin On This”, and finishing it unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason after “Here, Kitty Kitty” and follow the purple lab markers.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs, then complete “Spin On This”.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations, tracked under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. This is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as possibly missable: the first meditation, at Jason’s house in Chapter 1, can only be done during Chapter 1. After the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony; follow her, choose “Accept”, and she shows you how. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — PowerPyx earned the trophy having done it. Protect yourself: do it in Chapter 1, keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, and never use cheats (they disable trophies and saving). The last meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after “Coffee Break” in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.
steps: In Chapter 1, after “Down to Earth”: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and Accept the meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots with both characters (10 locations).
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 in case the first meditation is required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline gets marked after the Chapter 2 main mission “Coffee Break”: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, “Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret)”, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message, so this strand is Jason-only). After meeting him he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to Bret as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle “Killtelligence SM-69”, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for the 100% checklist. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal unlocks this trophy, so work the strand through and the trophy should come with it.
steps: After “Coffee Break”, play as Jason and answer Bret’s text to start “Veteran Hunted” in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret marks and bring them back to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 collectible card set locations, so the sets are findable rather than random: work through the locations, and finishing any 3 complete sets unlocks the trophy. Card sets are a pure collectible hunt, best done while exploring for the other collectibles.
steps: Find card sets across Leonida — PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Hold Up and then R1 while looking at a scannable object in the world. PowerPyx breaks the scannables into 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher Tags, and there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count — you do not need a specific set. Scanning is also how you discover vehicles, so this comes naturally while working on “Whip It Good”.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) at scannable objects.
Scan any 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. PowerPyx notes you only need 50 for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so you will unlock this automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges, where a checkmark shows each completed one. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; save this for late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to finish it off.
steps: Work through challenges naturally while doing other trophies.
Check Progress > Challenges and finish the easiest ones until 50 are done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you and escape the heat. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 main mission “Coffee Break”, when you can free-roam together and call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — PowerPyx recommends a fast sports motorcycle and, if a helicopter chases you, shooting at it until it leaves; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because cops struggle to follow on the tracks. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”, when the big bank-vault robberies give you 4-star wanted levels.
steps: After “Coffee Break”, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel helps.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. This also needs the post-“Coffee Break” partner system: call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while staying wanted the whole time — you want to keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. PowerPyx recommends an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and a good spot is the 3 Jewelry Stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs”. Rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs; if the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth. Note the unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
steps: After “Coffee Break”, call your partner and rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted.
Loot each shop properly, including the back-room safe; keep going to a 4th shop if it does not pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly — then look at vehicles and hold R1 to scan them; scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch, and the fastest method is to stand by a busy road and scan everything passing. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base models for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically on that road.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1.
Discover any 100 — a busy road is the fastest spot.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. PowerPyx recommends buffing focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and taking Adrenaline to extend the effect (hold L1, then press Triangle). Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations are a good target — and drop them quickly without missing, using an assault rifle like the Duke 556 for accuracy and full-auto fire, and body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you have done the other trophies you will likely be at level 4, which makes this much easier.
steps: Raise your Focus level (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots).
Buff focus, take Adrenaline, then activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and down 5 enemies in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) by stealing one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal. PowerPyx says it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the ones parked on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, whose door leads straight inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are far enough out. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the passenger plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and the trophy pops once you are in it and shooting. PowerPyx places the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and fire at enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County (south-west edge of the map).
Enter a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry-store robberies themselves, which are then marked with green icons in unfogged areas. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun (choose it over kicking the door, which triggers the alarm). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location.
steps: Finish “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs” to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store’s back door with the Snap Gun, loot the safe, destroy the footage and disable the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)”, which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches bank-vault robbery: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, the vault opens, and you go in and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that quest, pay Yasmani — the fence from Chapter 3, after his two Payday Loans robberies — $10,000 for tips that mark security vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist, so you will earn it automatically.
steps: Finish “That’s Where The Money Is…” to unlock bank-vault robberies.
Follow security vans (Yasmani’s $10,000 tips mark them), rob 5 vaults and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. PowerPyx says this unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission, “That’s Where The Money Is…”: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay ’n’ Spray. There is also an earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one’s path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests). Either way the trophy only pops after you escape the heat radius.
steps: Finish “That’s Where The Money Is…” — the bank-vault robbery counts — or
Block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, loot it and escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. PowerPyx recommends doing it by plane: fly over every black-fogged part of the map until the entire map is visible. It is a pure flying job, and doing it early also reveals the activity and collectible markers you will need for the other trophies.
steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map until nothing is blacked out.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. PowerPyx counts 39 illegal gang operations in total; you only need one per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% checklist, so it comes automatically on that road. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Rob illegal operations (yellow map icons) until you have hit one for each of the 9 gangs.
All 39 are needed for 100%, so keep clearing them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx has this one pinned down: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy pops. It is a small moment trophy — no questline, no grind, just the right bar and the right drink.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx says you need one specific car: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)”. Hack into the blue Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window. The unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away on the street — and only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car. It is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: After “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs”, go to the showroom in south Vice City.
Use the Key Cloner on the blue Banshee and drive it through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. PowerPyx says you go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”, which is marked automatically. Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, collect the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant “Gutterball Moreland 850” on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for the rest — it is not missable.
steps: During “Hit Kingpin Bowling”, take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police; return later if any of the 3 valuables was missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 main mission “Coffee Break”, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then “Strength” (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness-club membership and filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double progress.
steps: After “Coffee Break”, work out at fitness clubs with both characters together.
Bring both Jason and Lucia to maximum strength at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. PowerPyx recommends turning on criminal-profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile — every time you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that PowerPyx advises avoiding, since cops become more aggressive. You will very likely reach 500 naturally while doing the other trophies and the 100% checklist; if not, it can be farmed late by running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters all count — until 500 actions are logged.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. The official description, “Second time’s the charm”, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. Until a method is confirmed, do not chase a specific trick: play the Prologue’s Payday Loans content, and if a first attempt at something there fails, try it again. This guide will not invent a location or a step for it — the entry is marked unconfirmed, and the source below is where the confirmation will appear.
steps: Keep this one for later and watch the cited guide for a confirmed method.
PowerPyx currently lists it as unknown, believed to involve the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx has the method: go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo. It is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
steps: At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for the blinking car; if it is absent, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman it drops and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The official description, “Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by”, points the same way: a melee attack delivered from a moving vehicle. Until a method is confirmed, the honest advice is to try melee kicks at enemies while riding a motorcycle and watch for the pop. This guide will not invent a location or a step for it — the entry is marked unconfirmed, and the source below is where the confirmation will appear.
steps: Keep this one for later and watch the cited guide for a confirmed method.
PowerPyx currently lists it as unknown, believed to be a melee kick from a motorcycle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew)” — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies; you do not need to bring it all at once. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery — though those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…”.
steps: Finish “Credit Check” to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver marked bills to a fence until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. There is no trick to it — it is cumulative spending, and it comes naturally across a full playthrough. PowerPyx says the fastest way is to buy the most expensive things: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay ’n’ Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so there is no shortage of places to spend.
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items — until $100,000 is spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PowerPyx counts 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story-related ones that do not count for this trophy), costing $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 main mission “Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses)”, when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone — buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.
steps: After “Daily Driver”, open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which lets you have stolen vehicles delivered to your location. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”. You need parking first, so buy garages (see “Little Boxes”) — each garage adds one or more spots. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose “Respray” and then “Register”. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay ’n’ Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
steps: Buy garages first so you have parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose “Respray”, then “Register”.
